title: Fix N+1 query pattern in report generator
description: The report generator fetches a list of orders and then, for each order individually, issues a separate query to fetch its line items, resulting in an N+1 query pattern that dominates report generation time for large order sets. Fix it to use a single batched fetch for line items across all orders in the report.
acceptanceCriteria: Generating a report for N orders issues a constant, small number of queries regardless of N (not one query per order for line items).
The report's output content is identical to before the optimization for the same input data.
A performance test asserts the query count for a 200-order report is below a fixed small threshold, where it previously scaled linearly with order count.
verificationMethod: test-suite: assert the query-count threshold for a large order set via an instrumented performance test, plus existing content-correctness tests unchanged.
groundTruth: Line items are fetched once via a single query filtered by the full set of order IDs (WHERE order_id IN (...)) and then grouped in memory by order ID before being attached to each order in the report.
